_roles._about: Generic design-system names for this site's palette. Nothing in the app reads this block — it is documentation, so someone expecting primary/secondary/backdrop naming can find their way around. The values name the token each role maps to; themeToCss() also emits --primary, --secondary etc. as aliases.
_roles.primary: colors.seal          #4A3C96  印章紫 — links, active nav, buttons, rules
_roles.secondaryLight: colors.goldLight     #F0D48C  gold text on dark grounds
_roles.secondaryDark: surfaces.goldInk     #8E6A1A  gold text on LIGHT grounds (contrast-safe)

_fonts._about: typography.fonts holds a ROLE ID, not a font name — next/font compiles faces at build time, so a name typed here would not load. This block says what each role resolves to. To add a face, add it to app/fonts.ts AND FONT_ROLES in lib/theme-css.ts together.
_fonts.serif-sc: 思源宋体 简 Noto Serif SC 700 — self-hosted webfont, falls back to 宋体 Songti SC. Used for headings.
_fonts.system-sc: 系统黑体 — 苹方 PingFang SC (Mac) / 冬青黑体 Hiragino Sans GB / 微软雅黑 Microsoft YaHei (Windows). No download. Used for body text.
_fonts.system-serif-sc: 系统宋体 — 宋体 Songti SC / SimSun. No download. Available, not currently used.
_fonts.plex-mono: IBM Plex Mono — Latin only, no Chinese glyphs. Digits, dates and English only, never Chinese.

_preset.name: 紫金（当前）
_preset.description: 现行配色：紫底金字，米白正文底。
